text.text: The Cisco ASR 1001-HX Router is a 1-rack unit (1RU) platform suited for high-end enterprise branch offices or high performance private WAN. Its compact form factor has a built-in route processor (RP) and embedded services processor (ESP).

graphic.text: The Cisco ASR 1001-HX Router is a 1-rack unit (1RU) platform suited for high-end enterprise branch offices or high performance private WAN. Its compact form factor has a built-in route processor (RP) and embedded services processor (ESP).

text.text: Up to 60 Gbps of total system bandwidth Field replaceable, optional, Crypto module capable of up to 29-Gb bandwidth Support for built-in front panel 4x10GE, 8x1GE, and 4 configurable 10-Gibabit-Ethernet (GE) and 1-GE ports Two AC or DC power supplies One field-replaceable fan tray for front-to-back airflow
